description: These small data packages from the Hotmaps project give yearly scenario data for electricity and district heating at national (NUTS0) level for a current policy and an ambitious policy scenario. They were prepared by Gustav Resch and first held in the Hotmaps GitLab repositories, then archived on Zenodo. One package gives generation shares split into fossil fuels, renewables and nuclear, another gives CO2 emission factors for electricity and district heating, and a third gives the related scenario data on electricity and district heating. Coverage is European countries at national level with yearly values. Files are small ZIP archives of CSV tables (tens of kilobytes) on Zenodo (version 0.1.0, issued August 2018, archived April 2021) under CC-BY-4.0 at no cost. Caveats: the scenarios date from 2018 and the Zenodo pages give little detail on years, countries or methods, which are in the Hotmaps documentation. Simulation uses are setting carbon factors and supply mixes for heat planning and district heating studies in the Hotmaps toolbox and other models. Related records: none linked on the provider's pages read on the day.
